versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No changes to functional logic or configuration.
- Documentation and workflow remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the 货币与石油价格服务 (Currency and Oil Price Service) skill.
- Provides real-time currency exchange rates (USD/RUB, EUR/RUB) and Brent crude oil prices (in USD or RUB per barrel) from zenrus.ru.
- Supports calculation of how many barrels of Brent crude oil can be purchased for a given amount in RUB, USD, or EUR.
- Mandatory API key required: prompts user for key if missing and securely stores it.
- User intent is routed to the correct tool function based on input, with automatic parameter extraction and missing parameter prompts.
- Detailed project structure and operation workflow included.
